name: Augmented Dodecahedron
nu_polynomial_evidence: numerical, not proved in Lean: it vanishes at nu to 2000 digits

pose.meaning: the plug nu * R1 v + (t, 0), the hole R2 v; along z the plug's shadow is inside the hole's (weakly)

system.meaning: the polynomials p (p = 0) have exactly one common real root with every variable in its bounds (lo <= x <= hi); at it the first variable is nu (Result.lean)
